name: Pair of K16 turbochargers of the 993 Turbo (PicoGK display concept)
picogk_enhancement: Bionic: both turbochargers (housings, gas paths, flanges, crossover, wheels) are kept exactly from the functional model (shaping.base_stl); the straight wastegate-actuator strut of each unit is replaced by a bracket grown by 3D SIMP topology optimization (bionic.json, topopt.py) between the turbine housing and the actuator can, for an assumed 157 N diaphragm reaction (0.8 bar on a 50 mm diaphragm) and 30 g vibration of a 0.6 kg actuator (177 N vertical, lateral and fore-aft), with 7.5 mm clearance kept around the actuator rod and lever. PicoGK smooths it into an organic, branching bracket. Loads are assumptions, not measurements.

unit_length_mm.note: FVD product envelope per turbo 280 x 190 x 210 mm (right-hand 99312301452; left-hand page states the same)

unit_width_mm.note: FVD product envelope per turbo; sets the compressor volute outer diameter

pair_spacing_mm.note: left-right centre distance supposed (legacy concept hypothesis)

turbine_volute_outer_radius_mm.note: turbine volute outer radius (legacy concept turbine cylinder radius 85 mm)

compressor_inlet_bore_diameter_mm.note: inlet bore ahead of the 40.6 mm inducer; not measured

turbine_outlet_bore_diameter_mm.note: outlet bore behind the 48.97 mm exducer; not measured
